name: Experiment Notebook
description: Internal nonclinical R&D notebook with protocol version history, linked bench observations, replicate-level assays and reviewed scientific summaries for small biotech teams.
whenToUse: Use when a small biotech or academic R&D team needs an evidence-first internal nonclinical experiment history, exact protocol references, bench measurement records and human-reviewed findings.
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a regulated/GxP ELN, clinical/patient data system, human biospecimen tracker, laboratory instrument connection, file hosting system, or automated research-signature tool.

tableMap.description: Role mappings with real authorized UUID table IDs, logical fields to actual schema keys, and authorized writableFields.

layoutProfile.description: JSON with native-reviewed heading/tabs/cols/visible; read fresh every render, not overwritten by stale local state.

asOf.description: Optional fixed YYYY-MM-DD data cutoff for QA; omitted means current UTC date.

demoLabel.description: Fictional demo-only label. Never seed samples into production.

instructions: Read current authoring and usage guidance completely (1.3.9 at creation), design kit, and this exact version/digest before editing. Experiment Notebook is for small biotech/nonclinical research teams, inspired by eLabFTW, not an installed eLabFTW integration. Internal TrialAgents identity and official linked platform watermark only: no in-app login, accounts, OAuth, credential storage, fabricated logos or remote assets. Preserve six specialized screens and the scientific paper-like layout. Create or reuse seven database roles: projects, experiments, protocols, observations, measurements, interpretations, reports. Use valid TrialAgents types text/number/date/boolean/select; strings for file URL and detailed method, NOT unsupported url/longtext schema kinds. Map logical camelCase fields to actual snake_case; real table UUIDs and schemaVersion/field manifests are mandatory. Bind only authorized fields; do not derive permissions from visible tabs. Use strong project-bound permission scopes (experiment and result links) and preserve method/source history. Screen section keys are presentation only, not separate security boundaries. Never seed demo data. Capture only nonclinical lab work: no patients, subject identifiers, human specimens, medical or clinical records. Never claim GxP validation, compliant signatures, automated instrument uploads, or full ELN functionality. Use stable experiment codes, dated observations, exact method version, individual source-backed replicates with units and controls. Protocol revisions already referenced by an experiment are immutable: Duplicate creates a new draft version; no rewriting historical protocol. Plot valid numeric readings within one selected analyte/unit; show sample n and sample SD only when n>=2, never infer p-values, significance, conversions or error bars. Incomplete or permission-denied data suppresses derived results. All edits, duplicates and soft Delete are reviewed records.propose with exact fields and existing expectedVersion; do not imply a proposed edit was saved. The native gear opens tracker:layout via templateLayoutSchema, reviewed customLayout/expected app version updates; don't create a fake in-app layout manager. Save the app first, verify app ID and reopen; never create duplicate saved apps on retry. Do not add per-app automation settings pages. Optional ChatGPT periodic internal scientific interpretation is only recommended metadata: after saving, read_automation_setup/list_app_automations/read_app_automation_guide and prepare_app_monitoring if specifically approved, using one shared runner with owner/workspace subscription and stable authoringKey; manual processing remains valid. If an approved separate internal email is required, use TrialAgents prepare_app_action after verified authorized report status transition (Draft → Reviewed), recipients owner/approved existing team only, with dedupe, no independent schedule for processing-to-email; ChatGPT must never send email. No mandatory external API, connector, export or instrument system. Test source with manifest and sanitized host, 390/768/1440 widths, read-denied and partial cases, conflicts, report approval, method version immutability and duplicates. Preserve source IDs, layout, access, archive and disabled automations on revisions. All controls use data-ui-state. Empty start: create a research project from the overview, then a protocol, then an experiment. Keep record drafts after proposal for cancellation/retry. After confirmed receipt reopen or cancel the draft. All critical sources must be complete before writes. Return Reviewed interpretations/reports to Draft and Completed experiments to Needs review before modifying supporting evidence; this is an app guard, not a database foreign-key or immutable-history guarantee.

quickStart: Open within existing TrialAgents account/workspace. No additional login or users, and official watermark already links to https://platform.trialagents.com.
Check latest authoring/usage guidance and template digest; read existing authorized schemas before creating any records.
Create or reuse nonclinical projects and exact versioned protocols, then linked experiments; map 7 roles using actual table UUIDs, field keys and manifests.
Start by entering objectives, hypotheses, approved method versions and run conditions; only authorized measurement and dated observation records count.
Plot source-backed numeric replicates with explicit matching unit; record separate scientific interpretation with limitations.
Draft a human-reviewed project memo in ChatGPT if wanted; use platform Automations only after separate authorization.
documentation.dataContract: Seven persistent role tables with stable UUID relationships: projects, experiments(projectId,protocolId), protocols(versionLabel), observations(experimentId), measurements(experimentId,analyte,condition,timePoint,replicate,value,unit,control,sourceRef), interpretations(experimentId), reports(projectId). No external or human subject information. Demo data is wholly local and fictional. Each role requires a real bound typeId and approved table-level manifest; logical camelCase keys map to actual snake_case column keys. No copied protocol text retroactively overwrites old source. Raw laboratory files are *references* only, not stored or uploaded by frontend-js. Fetch each role in <=7 pages of <=100 records; suppress derived metrics on partial/denied result, never count a single page as total. Archive sets authorized archived:true with reviewed update; not hard deletion. Fields remain scalar except explicit text lists in batch references. Optional project segregation requires backend permissions; custom screens have app-level access only. All fields are scalar multiple:false. Optional empty values are null; required fields cannot be empty. Physical keys and exact select options are specified in the role schemas below. Relation text stores saved record UUIDs, not labels or arrays. Create parents first and substitute committed receipt IDs. Table map is a JSON string keyed by role: {typeId:actual UUID,fields:{logicalName:physical_key},writableFields:[authorized logical names]}. Bind all readable physical keys and manifest fields with current schemaVersion/kind/mode. Missing mappings, unknown totals, arrays and truncated reads are incomplete, not zero. Keep different recorded time points in separate descriptive groups even when analyte, unit and condition match.
documentation.interactionContract: Six screens with native layout settings. Every selector/filter and form control is transient marked UI state. Project create/edit/duplicate/archive controls are in the overview; protocol creation is in Protocol references. Other roles offer reviewed CRUD from their registers. Search is limited to the loaded authorized window (maximum 700 per role), with incomplete notice beyond it; registers page at configured 10–50 rows. Layout column order/visibility affects configured tables and drawer fields, with hidden fields reachable under Additional fields. Drafts remain after proposal and on errors; only trusted confirmation saves. Cancel closes a local draft. Source dots open the measurement details. Reviewed scientific evidence is frozen until dependent findings/reports return to Draft and experiments to Needs review. Delete means reviewed archive and dependency checks repeat at confirmation. No generated automation settings or account UI.
documentation.lifecycle: Pin exact app/template version and digest, use one requestKey for first save, verify saved app ID/version and reopen. Revise existing app only with expectedVersion; reuse the same request key after an ambiguous response and reconcile transaction receipt; never create new app to recover. Source references and method versions remain stable. Permission revocation and stale versions prevent edits. Layout revisions update only heading/order/visibility. App archive suspends linked automations; restore does not implicitly reenable them; disabled automation edits preserve disabled state. Initial app and records load without any automation running. No GxP signature or immutable audit validation claim.
limitations: Not a certified ELN, GxP solution, laboratory instrument connection, raw-file hosting system, human biobank, clinical patient repository, or eLabFTW integration.
Seven roles require actual authorized tables, binding manifests, schema versions and per-record review before production use. The standalone HTML is a synthetic local simulation.
Custom frontend-js screens inherit app-level authorization only. A hidden screen, field or experiment filter cannot enforce fine-grained database segregation by itself.
The sandbox has no network, storage, server timestamps, file upload or external LLM. Research summaries must be saved as approved records through trusted ChatGPT/TrialAgents workflow.

Results show simple descriptive mean and sample standard deviation of valid same-unit recorded values; do not infer biological replication, uncertainty intervals, p-values or statistical significance.
Original protocols with linked experiments cannot be edited or archived in the template; a production server must independently enforce immutable method revision history.
No automation is enabled by the template and optional monitoring requires current setup/permissions/owner approval; requested model/reasoning settings cannot be verified through task tools.
Trusted platform watermark supplies real official TrialAgents icon and link; generated source intentionally omits duplicate logo.

tasks.whenUseful: After explicitly approved project reviews, propose a weekly or monthly nonclinical evidence summary, or a separately approved internal notification of verified Reviewed status. Default is no automation.
tasks.readRequirements: Only after app save and user authorization: read_automation_setup, list_app_automations, read_app_automation_guide. If shared runner is connected and approved, prepare one app-linked ChatGPT monitor; suggested weekly Europe/Berlin Monday 09:00 only when owner requests cadence. Stable authoringKey life.experiment-notebook.weekly-science-review.v1. Read only currently authorized project/experiment/protocol/observation/measurement/interpretation records; no patient identifiers, lab file secrets, instrument API or unreviewed source outside scope. Match selected project IDs and allow only approved own-project review proposals. No automatic duplicate experiment creation. Use a current cutoff/last reviewed record identifier and coverage/dedupe keys; no_update if no eligible new source-backed findings where user approved quiet completion. Respect explicit authorization expiry; expired or revoked grants stop writes. Inherit current app access, never grant it. Bound each run to one project and at most 700 records per role, checkpoint only verified complete coverage. Keep disabled definitions disabled on edit; inspect outcomes in platform Logs. No host subscription means setup pending, not activated.
tasks.outputContract: Produce source-linked nonclinical scientific memo draft with cutoff, used experiment IDs, exact versioned protocols, value/unit/replicate counts, stated controls, descriptive statistics, missing data, uncertainties and limitations. No inferential statistics or invented results. Proposed report is Draft and must undergo trusted human review before status Reviewed. Optional separate TrialAgents email action only on transition into Reviewed for an authorized report; owner and explicitly selected existing TrialAgents team members, never external correspondents or data-field addresses. Use stable authoringKey life.experiment-notebook.internal-reviewed-memo-email.v1. Backend deduplicates and rechecks current grant; suppress on cancelled/archived/superseded/partial/failure. ChatGPT does not send; no independent email schedule if linked to processing. Log failure without blocking notebook and do not rerun successful research because email failed. Email subject: Research summary reviewed. Fixed body: A reviewed research summary is available in TrialAgents. Open https://platform.trialagents.com to inspect authorized details. Do not invent interpolation tokens. Use the current typed database field-transition email action from read_app_automation_guide, not a digest/report mode. Platform applies coalescing, current-state checks, recipient limits and cancellation; never bypass them.
tasks.promptExample: For the authorized project and approved coverage window, read complete experiments, exact protocols, observations, measurements and interpretations. Deduplicate by project ID, coverage window and source record IDs/versions. Propose one Draft report with cutoff, source experiment codes, factual findings, units, replicate counts and limitations. Never set Reviewed automatically. Do not advance coverage on partial/denied/failed reads. With complete coverage only, return no_update when no eligible evidence changed and the owner approved silence. Without approved ongoing write scope return a reviewable draft only. No automation is the default; manual entry and manual ChatGPT drafting remain available.

examples.prompt: Create an internal nonclinical experiment notebook with protocol versions, linked raw data references and descriptive result plots.
examples.expectedBehavior: Choose exact 1.2.1 template and real authorized 7-role schema, no app login or new owner accounts; preview empty first; do not seed fictional examples.

examples.prompt: Duplicate this assay protocol into a revised method and keep historical experiments linked to their original version.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create a Draft protocol revision using unique version label and source, never rewrite referenced v1.2; reviewed create and version receipt.

examples.prompt: Plot the assay result by dose and show mean, replicate count and SD without guessing units.
examples.expectedBehavior: Filter by experiment/analyte/exact recorded unit; show individual plotted source values, sample SD only for >=2, exclude incomplete or mismatched observations; no significance inference.

examples.prompt: Change an experiment from Running to Completed and prepare our monthly research summary.
examples.expectedBehavior: Completion requires end date and recorded dated observation plus numeric source-backed measurement; report Draft then human-reviewed. User may opt out of monitoring.

examples.prompt: Email the team whenever a reviewed experiment summary is available.
examples.expectedBehavior: Save app first, authorize separate TrialAgents action on report Draft → Reviewed transition with owner and approved current team only; not arbitrary email fields or ChatGPT sending.
